package: T03 PR #38 concurrency fault laboratory evidence

packageEvolution.metricDefinition: indexEntries = published files (evidence + top-level deliverables + integrity anchors). Local evidence file counts are a different metric (files in the local evidence directory, including harness-internal ones never published).

history.note: prFiles = indexEntries + 3 integrity-anchor files not yet indexed; 13 *.log files needed an explicit force-add against the repo-wide ignore rule

history.localEvidenceFiles: grew (A11 ledger, temp-dir ledger, B9R* rounds, logs)
history.note: same +3 anchor gap; evidence/wpB-b9r2.log was indexed but gitignored -> dangling reference discovered by review
zero dangling, zero unindexed; wpB-b9r2.log force-added after rescan

scopeNote: Evidence-only package for independent review of PR #38 (9dfc403f89cfe539eb7584c87eddcbda6efe0a89). No production code changes.

integrity.hashPolicy: originalSha256 hashes the LOCAL ORIGINAL file; publicSha256 hashes the sanitized copy published here. They intentionally differ wherever redactionRules is non-empty. Historical results were never altered to become PASS; intermediate failures and harness-defect iterations are preserved.
integrity.fieldNaming: sourceCommits holds git COMMIT SHAs of the tested implementations (new: 9dfc403…, old: 6a3eea2…). The R0/R1 releases misnamed this field sourceSha256; renamed in R1.1. File-level hashes are publicSha256/originalSha256 only.
redaction: personal-home-path: the personal home prefix (username withheld) was replaced with <redacted-home>
per-user-tmpdir: the per-user macOS temp root was replaced with <tmpdir>
integrity.enforced: every published file was re-scanned after sanitization; any surviving hit aborts the package build
